title: Welcome To The
description: Progression-based total joke mod made as a unique challenge for you and your friends to beat
body:
Welcome to Welcome To The
Welcome To The adds a lot of jokes and a long line of progression made to confuse and entertain you. It adds features like gunk, fart juice, American soda, johnium, the Refrigerator Dimension, and the all-powerful Wand Of The Gods. The mod is made with playing with friends and content creation in mind (free content I spent 3 months on just for you!!!)

[NEEDED GUIDE TO BEAT THE MOD](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1rn_LZxOFwOJ3vF6wA3BOd5uK_DvBdJj9Ayspp5-OKqo/edit?usp=sharing)
I get that some people, especially you challenge YouTubers, will want to try and beat it without a guide, but it's important to note that you GENUINELY CANNOT do this, you NEED the guide

Also note that I've only tested this on 1.21.8, idk if it works on 1.21.9-1.21.11, like it probably works but if your PC explodes while trying to play it on 1.21.11 then consider that your fault
